systems.system: Declaration of births and deaths in health facilities (bulletins de naissance)
systems.country_label: bulletins de naissance; bulletins de déclaration des naissances; outils d'enregistrement des décès
systems.platform: birth bulletins filled in at the facility
systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé Publique et de la Prévention
systems.tiers: health facilities, where a ministerial act makes declaration of births compulsory; the plan says the tools are not available at all levels and registration is only partly done, and aims at systematic registration in 100% of health establishments by 2030

systems.system: Mécanisme d'interopérabilité (health, communes, other ministries, ANATS)
systems.owner: Ministries in charge of health and of territorial administration, with communes and ANATS
systems.tiers: a formal framework of collaboration between civil-status centres and the health ministry, to be made operational under action 7.2.4

systems.system: Community health workers (ASC) recording civil-status events
systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé Publique et de la Prévention
systems.tiers: communities; training planned under the PNDS 4

note: Passages of the health sector plan for 2022-2030: its civil-status objective (OS 7) concerns declaration of births and deaths by health facilities and community workers to the registrar, which is notification; nothing is stated about how civil registration offices make their record, and no digital system is named.
